Package arcade.patch.agent.process

Class PatchProcessInflammationCD8

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcess
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessInflammation
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessInflammationCD8
All Implemented Interfaces:
Process
public class PatchProcessInflammationCD8 extends PatchProcessInflammation
Extension of PatchProcessInflammation for CD8 CAR T-cells

InflammationCD8 determines granzyme amounts produced for cytotoxic effector functions as a function of IL-2 bound and antigen-induced activation state.
